I verified:
- `python output/main.py --help` works
- JSON `write -> parse` works on minimal files
- `eval` works on a sample line entity
- `roundtrip` reaches a byte-stable fixed point on that sample

I did not exhaustively validate every IGES entity/form against real CAD corpora in this environment, so the implementation has only been smoke-tested here rather than fully certified across the whole spec surface.
